bookmark.status: Core proximity engine for help routing
priority: Minimum Beacon user density for feature activation

IO3_transformations.operation: Calculate dynamic radius from population density + user density + urgency
IO3_transformations.algorithm: Inverse density scaling with urgency multiplier

DW2_downstream_pipeline.description: Radius used to query nearby helpers

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Geospatial query on large user set. Census data staleness.
P.P2_defensibility: Dynamic radius avoids one-size-fits-all. Adapts to rural vs urban automatically.
P4_failure_modes: Census data outdated in rapidly changing areas
Beacon user density too low in new markets
Radius too large returns irrelevant helpers
P.P5_backup_plan: Fallback to fixed radius tiers (2km urban, 10km suburban, 30km rural) if density data unavailable.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Simulate failure scenario in staging with mock data
P.P7_testing_strategy: Unit test radius calculation. Integration test with mock density grids. A/B test radius sizes.
P.P8_benchmarks: Radius calculation <50ms. Correct tier selection >95% of cases.

F.F1_cost_considerations: Census API (free). Geohash computation negligible. Cache density grids in Redis.
F.F2_accounting_considerations: Allocated to help module operational budget

S.S1_cybersecurity: No PII in density calculations. Aggregated data only.
S.S2_data_privacy: User locations used for proximity only, not stored in this module.
